new_results.statement: For D_k^dis(A)=sum over disjoint ordered k-subsets S,T of det(A[S,T])^2, some fair physical cut I,J has Z_k=e_k(A[I,J]^T A[I,J]) >= 2^(-2k) D_k^dis(A).
||p_Q||_infinity <= 5 sqrt(2) e [D_5^dis(A)]^(-1/10) whenever D_5^dis(A)>0, with an L1 characteristic-function proof.
If D_4^dis(A)=0<D_3^dis(A), then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 12 [D_3^dis(A)]^(-1/6), by an actual application of account03/B02.

For a physical block with 4-volume row marginal h, sharp HY gives 2e Z_4^-1/8 for h<=1/2 and e/[sqrt(2h)(1-h)] Z_4^-1/8 for 1/2<h<1; exact rank-four endpoint failure is a physical leverage-one coloop.

If D-prime fails in both orientations of a physical cross block, some row i and column j jointly carry at least half the squared third-minor volume: sum_{S contains i,T contains j} det(M[S,T])^2 >= Z_3/2.

For exact rank three with one physical spectral-leverage-one row, rank-one compression to its orthogonal complement, and residual two-frame row leverages <=1/2, ||p_Q||_infinity <= 12/2^(2/3)|det Lambda|^(-1/3) <=7.559526300, with L1 Fourier control.

fresh_correction_application.application: Its star-plus-rank-one witness is exactly covered by QFORM-SPECTRAL-COLOOP-RANK1-COMPRESSION-MF-v1, yielding ||p_Q||_infinity <=7.559526300 |a|^(-2/3)|b|^(-1/3), while one-pair collision localization diverges.

first_unpaid_implication: Aggregate the joint row-column star mass forced by two-sided D-prime failure inside the near-coloop rank-four collar through an augmented mixed-hub/bank frame; in the exact spectral-coloop case handle rank-two compression or localized residual rows before any fractional collision endpoint.
